purpose: Two 16-job campaigns qualify existing archive SnapshotRoot integration and one/two physical result slots.
funding: Separate qualification block after S02 closure. All qualification search is diagnostic auxiliary work, never performance-search evidence.
pass_rule: Both roots match the frozen prepared snapshot, original E01 emulator bytes and raw context.
Both complete exactly 16 jobs under the unchanged ordinary policy; no root-inherited or post-budget milestone claim.
Both complete full campaign replay and two root-relative plus two full-prefix witness replays.
Same-host stream, origin/final checkpoint, campaign report and witness inputs are byte identical across one/two result slots.
Known helper setup/replay and engine admitted/replayed-admitted frames fit the separate 4M block; preserve unknown engine setup, unadmitted work and reconstruction.
Any identity, replay, wall, memory or output failure stops qualification; no retry, seed/root replacement or capability pilot follows automatically.
unknown: Engine setup/unadmitted/reconstruction are not part of this prepare-only phase. Later campaign qualification must retain those additional unknown costs.
